cases: Category partial draft, failed read, held create ACK and same-tick double click
Unit partial draft, failed read, held create ACK and same-tick double click
Existing catalogue management/supplier purchase history/inventory exports

invariants: Read failure retains previous rows and draft, prevents new mutation until successful retry.
Synchronous ref admits only one request even before React saving state commits.
ACK clears own draft and marks saved independently of a following read failure.
Legacy endpoints have no server operation key; no automatic retry or claimed original-key idempotency.
No physical inventory movements created by catalogue edits.
limits: No vendor, real delivery, hardware or production deployment.
